The 449 retained upstream files were compared byte-for-byte with that official
archive on 2026-10-25; none had source changes. Five legacy OpenCORE/Android
makefiles are omitted, not used by the supplied autotools iOS build:

opencore/codecs_v2/audio/gsm_amr/amr_nb/dec/build/make/local.mk
opencore/codecs_v2/audio/gsm_amr/amr_nb/common/build/make/local.mk
opencore/codecs_v2/audio/gsm_amr/amr_nb/enc/build/make/local.mk
opencore/codecs_v2/audio/gsm_amr/common/dec/build/make/local.mk
opencore/codecs_v2/audio/gsm_amr/amr_wb/dec/build/make/local.mk

LICENSE and opencore/NOTICE retain Apache-2.0 and PacketVideo attribution.
Generated prebuilt libraries are excluded from version control; build the iOS
archive with scripts/build_ios_vowifi_codecs.sh in the repository root.
